components.explanation: Clip 1, the cycle: Sprite2D KeycardIcon + AnimationPlayer frame track, keycard_spin.tres (8 keys at k/12, discrete, LOOP_LINEAR), the generated 8-cell sheet; its read-back and preview fixtures.
Clip 2, the committing action: Node2D cutout rig (Body/Slide/Mag, Polygon2D parts, RESET), pistol_reload.tres keyed from the phase table (24 fps, 1.25 s, LOOP_NONE); read-back, edge test, previews.
HudAnim, the one authority: two state tables, signal handlers, play/stop/RESET; attached in game.gd; the structure and state tests.
The player's reload state machine (unchanged): _reload_left on the process tick, the fire lock, reload_changed/died; the pins taken before wiring and the two-clocks measurement.
The HUD (unchanged in A7): PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS, the keycard label HudAnim reads.
